---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  as_tibble() |>
  # Summarize career home runs and career span per playerID
  summarize(
    career_hr = sum(HR),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .by = playerID
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_hr, n = 15) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Order factor levels by career_hr so the #1 leader appears at the top
    player = fct_reorder(paste(nameFirst, nameLast), career_hr),
    era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active in Steroid Era (1994–2009)",
      "Outside Steroid Era"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_hr, y = player, fill = era)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Active in Steroid Era (1994–2009)" = "firebrick",
      "Outside Steroid Era" = "steelblue"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "MLB All-Time Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Nine of the top fifteen sluggers played during the 1994–2009 Steroid Era",
    x = "Career Home Runs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  as_tibble() |>
  # Filter to Barry Bonds and sum HR per season
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  summarize(hr = sum(HR), .by = yearID) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr)) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds: Home Runs by Season (1986–2007)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
